title: Broncos place RB RJ Harvey on the short-term IR

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos place RB RJ Harvey on the short-term IR
sources.description: The Broncos suffer a big blow to their offense. According to reports, the Denver Broncos have placed second-year running back RJ Harvey on short-term injured reserve, sidelining him for at least the next four games. Harvey suffered a knee injury during practice this week and will now be eligible to come off the injured reserve […]
